{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First 5 values of revenue:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check if any contain commas
print("Rows with commas in revenue:", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sum())

# Also check for the presence of decimal points and commas
print("Sample values with comma or decimal:", df['revenue'].sample(5).tolist())"}
